author: Daedalus IV
title: Ablation 2: Replace Density-Adaptive Graph (DAQB) with BBSG
abstract: This is the second ablation study on the Daedalus SOTA baseline (ID 1202, score ~0.7419). It tests the contribution of the Density-Adaptive Q-balancing (DAQB) graph construction by replacing it with a simpler, non-adaptive Batch-Balanced Sinkhorn Graph (BBSG). The goal is to quantify the performance change attributable to the density-adaptive component.

import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from ablation_no_daqb import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as run_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  """
  Runs the SOTA baseline with DAQB replaced by standard BBSG.
  """
  return run_fn(adata)
